cover_title_pre: 5 AI stories you need to know

stories.headline: The DOJ launches a Super Intelligence Task Force
stories.summary: The unit will police misuse of advanced AI by foreign governments, criminal groups and fraudsters, and push AI developers to tighten internal controls and risk reporting.
stories.why: AI misuse is now a federal enforcement priority, not just a policy debate.

stories.headline: OpenAI's mega-round lands below its target
stories.summary: Reports say OpenAI's new round is priced around $1.25 trillion, down from the $1.4–1.5 trillion it reportedly sought, with about $11B in early commitments.
stories.why: Even the biggest names in AI are meeting tougher investors.

stories.stat_label: Apple's daily AI cap for some engineers
stories.headline: Big companies start rationing AI tools
stories.summary: Apple reportedly cut daily AI spending caps for some engineers, and Goldman Sachs pulled AI coding tools from traders and bankers, citing productivity and risk.
stories.why: The "unlimited AI" era inside companies is giving way to budgets.

stories.headline: Data centers lose at the ballot box
stories.summary: One tracker counts data center opponents winning 38 of 39 fully counted local measures in this week's elections.
stories.why: Power and land for AI are becoming a local political fight.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Lab nears a $5B raise
stories.summary: Mira Murati's startup is reportedly closing a $5B round led by Accel at a $40B pre-money valuation, and shipped its Inkling 2 Small model this week.
stories.why: Investors are still writing huge checks for frontier-lab challengers.
